mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and thus positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% in a quarter signals an improving labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as companies reduce output and investment.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) grow faster than GDP (GDPC1) over a quarter, it indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS growth > GDPC1 growth in 3 months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a month, coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE), signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 2% signals inflationary pressure, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as the Federal Reserve may tighten monetary policy.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the instances where the signal is active.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year growth rate of GDP (GDPC1) exceeds the growth rate of the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1%, it indicates strong real economic growth, which is a positive signal for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY growth > CPIAUCSL YoY growth by > 1%
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met.
